name: over
type: theorem over strict voting profiles. This file records the public decisive-coalition vocabulary for the strict ranked-ballot voting domain. The proof route is the standard one: 1. unanimity implies the grand coalition is decisive; 2. weak decisiveness for one ordered pair spreads to decisiveness for all pairs; 3. any decisive coalition of size at least two has a strictly smaller nonempty decisive subcoalition; 4. a minimal decisive coalition is a singleton; 5. the singleton voter is a dictator. -/ namespace SocialChoice namespace Voting variable {N A : Type*} /-- A coalition is decisive for `a` over `b` if unanimous strict support inside the coalition forces the social strict preference `a ≻ b`. -/

name: IsDecisiveFor
type: def IsDecisiveFor [Fintype N] [Fintype A] (F : SWF N A) (C : Set N) (a b : A) : Prop

name: IsDecisive
type: def IsDecisive [Fintype N] [Fintype A] (F : SWF N A) (C : Set N) : Prop

name: SWF.IsDictator
type: def SWF.IsDictator [Fintype N] [Fintype A] (F : SWF N A) (i : N) : Prop

name: unanimity_univ_isDecisive
type: theorem unanimity_univ_isDecisive [Fintype N] [Fintype A] {F : SWF N A} (h : SWF.Unanimity F) : IsDecisive F Set.univ

name: singleton_unanimity_isDictator
type: theorem singleton_unanimity_isDictator [Fintype N] [Fintype A] [Subsingleton N] {F : SWF N A} (h : SWF.Unanimity F) (i : N) : F.IsDictator i

name: singleton_unanimity_dictatorial
type: theorem singleton_unanimity_dictatorial [Fintype N] [Fintype A] [Subsingleton N] [Nonempty N] {F : SWF N A} (h : SWF.Unanimity F) : SWF.Dictatorial F

name: IsWeaklyDecisiveFor
type: def IsWeaklyDecisiveFor [Fintype N] [Fintype A] (F : SWF N A) (C : Set N) (a b : A) : Prop

name: isWeaklyDecisiveFor_of_isDecisiveFor
type: theorem isWeaklyDecisiveFor_of_isDecisiveFor [Fintype N] [Fintype A] {F : SWF N A} {C : Set N} {a b : A} (h : IsDecisiveFor F C a b) : IsWeaklyDecisiveFor F C a b

name: iia_strict
type: theorem iia_strict [Fintype N] [Fintype A] {F : SWF N A} (hF : SWF.IIA F) {P Q : Profile N A} {a b : A} (hab : ∀ i, Prefers P i a b ↔ Prefers Q i a b) (hba : ∀ i, Prefers P i b a ↔ Prefers Q i b a) : strict (F P) a b ↔ strict (F Q) a b

name: decisive_spread
type: theorem decisive_spread [Fintype N] [Fintype A] {F : SWF N A} (hU : SWF.Unanimity F) (hIIA : SWF.IIA F) {C : Set N} {x y z : A} (hxy : x ≠ y) (hxz : x ≠ z) (hyz : y ≠ z) (hC : Set.Nonempty C) (h : IsWeaklyDecisiveFor F C x y) : IsDecisive F C

name: exists_nonempty_decisive_of_size
type: def exists_nonempty_decisive_of_size [Fintype N] [Fintype A] (F : SWF N A) (n : Nat) : Prop

name: exists_minimal_decisive_coalition
type: theorem exists_minimal_decisive_coalition [Fintype N] [Nonempty N] [Fintype A] {F : SWF N A} (hU : SWF.Unanimity F) : ∃ n, Minimal (exists_nonempty_decisive_of_size F) n

name: decisive_contraction
type: theorem decisive_contraction [Fintype N] [Fintype A] {F : SWF N A} (h0 : ∃ x y z : A, x ≠ y ∧ x ≠ z ∧ y ≠ z) {C : Set N} (hCdec : IsDecisive F C) (hCcard : 2 ≤ C.ncard) (hU : SWF.Unanimity F) (hIIA : SWF.IIA F) : ∃ S : Set N, S.Nonempty ∧ S < C ∧ IsDecisive F S

name: decisive_minimal
type: theorem decisive_minimal [Fintype N] [Nonempty N] [Fintype A] (h0 : ∃ x y z : A, x ≠ y ∧ x ≠ z ∧ y ≠ z) {F : SWF N A} (hU : SWF.Unanimity F) (hIIA : SWF.IIA F) : Minimal (exists_nonempty_decisive_of_size F) 1

name: arrow_of_unanimity_iia
type: theorem arrow_of_unanimity_iia [Fintype N] [Nonempty N] [Fintype A] (h0 : ∃ x y z : A, x ≠ y ∧ x ≠ z ∧ y ≠ z) {F : SWF N A} (h1 : SWF.Unanimity F) (h2 : SWF.IIA F) : SWF.Dictatorial F
